title: The First Will Be Last
description: What does it look like to trust God when nothing is going to plan?
This week we open Mark 9:30–50 and ask what the passage is really saying, before we ask what it means for us.
We notice how the passage fits into the larger story of The Servant King, and what has come just before it.
Along the way we meet some familiar excuses, and some better reasons to hope.
